        .ascension-hero {
            position: relative;

        .ascension-hero-shade {

        .ascension-hero-caption {

        .ascension-hero-kicker {

        .ascension-hero-caption p { margin: .55rem 0 0; font-size: clamp(.9rem, 1.6vw, 1.1rem); color: #d4f8f5; font-weight: 500; }
        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .ascension-hero {
                min-height: 0;

            .ascension-hero-caption { left: 1rem; right: 1rem; bottom: 1rem; }
            .ascension-hero-kicker { font-size: .58rem; letter-spacing: .12em; }

CTIL A320"},{"brand":"ZTE","model":"Táctil L130","quality":"Táctil","basePrice":5.0,"outOfStock":true,"sourceDescription":"TACTIL ZTE L130","groupKey":"ZTE T CTIL L130"},{"brand":"ZTE","model":"Táctil Z812","quality":"Táctil","basePrice":5.0,"outOfStock":true,"sourceDescription":"TACTIL ZTE Z812","groupKey":"ZTE T CTIL Z812"},{"brand":"ZTE","model":"Táctil Z835 / Z851","quality":"Táctil","basePrice":5.0,"outOfStock":true,"sourceDescription":"TACTIL ZTE Z835 / Z851","groupKey":"ZTE T CTIL Z835 Z851"}];

        // Processed Catalog with Labor added
        let catalogData = rawDatabase.map(item => ({
            ...item,
            finalPriceUSD: item.basePrice + LABOR_COST
        }));

        let activeBrand = 'Todos';

        window.onload = function() {
            renderTabs();
            updateRatesUI();
            renderCatalog();

            // Search bar listener
            document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', function() {
                renderCatalog();
            });
        };

        function renderTabs() {
            // Marcas destacadas primero; se conserva el resto del catálogo.
            const featured = ['iPhone', 'Xiaomi', 'Infinix', 'Samsung', 'Tecno'];
            const allBrands = [...new Set(catalogData.map(item => item.brand))].filter(b => b !== 'Otros').sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'es'));
            const brands = ['Todos', ...featured.filter(b => allBrands.includes(b)), ...allBrands.filter(b => !featured.includes(b)), ...(catalogData.some(item => item.brand === 'Otros') ? ['Otros'] : [])];
            const container = document.getElementById('brand-tabs');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            brands.forEach((brand, index) => {
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.className = `px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all border ${
                    activeBrand === brand
                    ? 'bg-brand-neon text-brand-black border-brand-neon shadow-md neon-glow'
                    : 'bg-brand-black text-gray-300 border-brand-border hover:text-white hover:border-brand-neon/60'
                }`;
                button.innerText = brand;
                button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', activeBrand === brand ? 'true' : 'false');
                button.onclick = () => {
                    activeBrand = brand;
                    renderTabs();
                    renderCatalog();
                };
                container.appendChild(button);
            });
        }

        function qualityOrder(quality) {
            const q = String(quality || '').toLowerCase();
            if (q.includes('incell')) return 0;
            if (q.includes('amoled')) return 1;
            if (q.includes('oled')) return 2;
            if (q.includes('original')) return 3;
            return 4;
        }

        function renderCatalog() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('catalog-grid');
            const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');
            const searchVal = document.getElementById('search-input').value.toLowerCase().trim();
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            const filtered = catalogData.filter(item => {
                const matchesBrand = activeBrand === 'Todos' || item.brand === activeBrand;
                const matchesSearch = item.model.toLowerCase().includes(searchVal) ||
                                      item.brand.toLowerCase().includes(searchVal) ||
                                      item.quality.toLowerCase().includes(searchVal);
                return matchesBrand && matchesSearch;
            });

            // Agrupar por modelo para que, si hay varias calidades registradas en el futuro,
            // aparezcan juntas y ordenadas: INCELL primero, después AMOLED y Original.
            const groupsMap = new Map();
            filtered.forEach(item => {
                const key = item.groupKey || `${item.brand}::${item.model}`;
                if (!groupsMap.has(key)) groupsMap.set(key, []);
                groupsMap.get(key).push(item);
            });
            const groups = Array.from(groupsMap.values());
            groups.forEach(options => options.sort((a, b) => qualityOrder(a.quality) - qualityOrder(b.quality)));

            document.getElementById('results-count').innerText = groups.length;

            if (groups.length === 0) {
                emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
                return;
            }
            emptyState.classList.add('hidden');

            groups.forEach(options => {
                const first = options[0];
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'bg-brand-card rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 border border-brand-border hover:border-brand-neon/50 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col group relative overflow-hidden';

                const optionsHtml = options.map((item, index) => {
                    const priceBs = Number.isFinite(usdRate) ? (item.finalPriceUSD * usdRate).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : 'No disponible';
                    const priceEur = (Number.isFinite(usdRate) && Number.isFinite(eurRate) && eurRate > 0) ? (item.finalPriceUSD * (usdRate / eurRate)).toLocaleString('es-VE', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) : 'No disponible';
                    const qualityLabel = String(item.quality).toUpperCase();
                    const isIncell = qualityLabel.includes('INCELL');
                    const waMessage = encodeURIComponent(`Hola Ascension, estoy interesado en la pantalla de *${item.model}*, calidad *${item.quality}*, por *$${item.finalPriceUSD} USD* (${priceBs} Bs. / €${priceEur}). ¿Tienen disponibilidad?`);
                    const waLink = `https://wa.me/584129623503?text=${waMessage}`;
                    const optionId = `prices-${catalogData.indexOf(item)}`;
                    return `
                        <div class="rounded-xl border ${isIncell ? 'border-brand-neon/50 bg-brand-neon/5' : 'border-brand-border bg-brand-black/40'} p-3 ${index ? 'mt-2' : ''}">
                            <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2">
                                <div>
                                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                        <span class="text-sm font-extrabold ${isIncell ? 'text-brand-neon' : 'text-white'}">${item.quality}</span>
                                        ${isIncell ? '<span class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider bg-brand-neon text-brand-black font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">Opción económica</span>' : ''}
                                        ${item.outOfStock ? '<span class="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider bg-red-500/15 text-red-300 border border-red-400/30 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">Agotado en lista</span>' : ''}
                                    </div>
                                    <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-500">Pantalla + $15 de mano de obra</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-right shrink-0">
                                    <div class="text-2xl font-black font-tech text-white">$${item.finalPriceUSD.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}</div>
                                    <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500">USD</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <details class="text-xs mb-3">
                                <summary class="cursor-pointer text-gray-400 hover:text-brand-cyan select-none">Ver equivalencias en Bs. y euros</summary>
                                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mt-2">
                                    <div class="rounded-lg bg-brand-black/70 px-3 py-2"><div class="text-gray-500 mb-1">Bolívares</div><div class="text-brand-neon font-bold">${priceBs} Bs.</div></div>
                                    <div class="rounded-lg bg-brand-black/70 px-3 py-2"><div class="text-gray-500 mb-1">Euros</div><div class="text-brand-cyan font-bold">€${priceEur}</div></div>
                                </div>
                            </details>
                            <a href="${waLink}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                               class="w-full bg-brand-neon/10 hover:bg-brand-neon text-brand-neon hover:text-brand-black border border-brand-neon/40 hover:border-brand-neon font-bold py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs">
                                <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp text-base"></i><span>${item.outOfStock ? 'Consultar disponibilidad' : 'Consultar esta calidad'}</span>
                            </a>
                        </div>`;
                }).join('');

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
                        <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand-neon px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-brand-neon/10 border border-brand-neon/20">${first.brand}</span>
                        <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-medium"><i class="fa-solid fa-check text-brand-neon mr-1"></i>Consulta disponible</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 class="text-lg sm:text-xl font-extrabold text-white group-hover:text-brand-neon transition-colors mb-1">${first.brand} ${first.model}</h3>
                    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3">Selecciona la calidad de pantalla que prefieras:</p>
                    <div>${optionsHtml}</div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function formatRateDate(isoDate) {
            if (!isoDate) return 'Sin fecha verificada';
            const match = String(isoDate).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/);
            return match ? `${match[3]}/${match[2]}/${match[1]}` : String(isoDate);
        }

        function caracasTodayISO() {
            const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
                timeZone: 'America/Caracas', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit'
            }).formatToParts(new Date());
            const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
            return `${values.year}-${values.month}-${values.day}`;
        }

        function setRateStatus(message, tone = 'muted') {
            const el = document.getElementById('rate-status-label');
            if (!el) return;
            el.innerText = message;
            el.className = `text-[10px] ${tone === 'good' ? 'text-brand-neon' : tone === 'warn' ? 'text-amber-300' : 'text-gray-500'}`;
        }

        function persistRates() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(RATE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                    USD: usdRate,
                    EUR: eurRate,
                    date: rateSourceDate,
                    mode: rateMode,
                    updatedAt: rateUpdatedAt
                }));
            } catch (error) {
                // El catálogo sigue funcionando aunque el navegador bloquee el almacenamiento local.
                console.warn('No se pudo guardar la tasa en este navegador.', error);
            }
        }

        function restoreRatesCache() {
            try {
                const cached = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RATE_CACHE_KEY) || 'null');
                if (!cached || !(Number(cached.USD) > 0) || !(Number(cached.EUR) > 0) || !cached.date) return false;
                usdRate = Number(cached.USD);
                eurRate = Number(cached.EUR);
                rateSourceDate = cached.date;
                rateMode = cached.mode === 'manual' ? 'manual' : 'cached';
                rateUpdatedAt = cached.updatedAt || null;
                updateRatesUI();
                setRateStatus(rateMode === 'manual' ? 'Tasa manual guardada en este navegador' : 'Última tasa guardada; verificando actualización…', 'warn');
                renderCatalog();
                return true;
            } catch (error) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        function updateRatesUI() {
            const dateLabel = document.getElementById('rate-date-label');
            document.getElementById('usd-rate-label').innerText = Number.isFinite(usdRate) ? `${usdRate.toLocaleString('es-VE', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 4})} Bs.` : 'No disponible';
            document.getElementById('eur-rate-label').innerText = Number.isFinite(eurRate) ? `${eurRate.toLocaleString('es-VE', {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 4})} Bs.` : 'No disponible';
            if (dateLabel) dateLabel.innerText = rateSourceDate ? formatRateDate(rateSourceDate) : 'Sin verificar';
            document.getElementById('modal-usd-input').value = Number.isFinite(usdRate) ? usdRate : '';
            document.getElementById('modal-eur-input').value = Number.isFinite(eurRate) ? eurRate : '';
        }

        async function loadAutomaticRates(userInitiated = false) {
            if (rateIsRefreshing) return;
            rateIsRefreshing = true;
            const button = document.getElementById('refresh-rates-button');
            const icon = document.getElementById('refresh-rates-icon');
            if (button) button.disabled = true;
            if (button) button.classList.add('opacity-50', 'cursor-wait');
            if (icon) icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
            if (!Number.isFinite(usdRate) || !Number.isFinite(eurRate)) {
                const dateLabel = document.getElementById('rate-date-label');
                if (dateLabel) dateLabel.innerText = 'Consultando…';
            }
            if (window.location.protocol === 'file:') {
                if (restoreRatesCache()) {
                    setRateStatus('Vista local: la tasa automática requiere abrir la página desde una web HTTPS', 'warn');
                } else {
                    updateRatesUI();
                    setRateStatus('Para actualizar automáticamente, la página debe estar publicada en una web HTTPS', 'warn');
                }
                rateIsRefreshing = false;
                if (button) button.disabled = false;
                if (button) button.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-wait');
                if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
                return;
            }
            setRateStatus('Consultando fuente de tasas…');
            try {
                let data = null;
                let lastError = null;
                for (const apiUrl of RATE_API_URLS) {
                    try {
                        const response = await fetch(`${apiUrl}?_=${Date.now()}`, {
                            cache: 'no-store',
                            headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' }
                        });
                        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`La fuente respondió ${response.status}`);
                        const candidate = await response.json();
                        const candidateUsd = Number(candidate.USD);
                        const candidateEur = Number(candidate.EUR);
                        const candidateDate = candidate.effective_date || candidate.date;
                        if (!(candidateUsd > 0) || !(candidateEur > 0) || !candidateDate) throw new Error('La respuesta de tasas está incompleta');
                        data = candidate;
                        break;
                    } catch (sourceError) { lastError = sourceError; }
                }
                if (!data) throw (lastError || new Error('No se pudo consultar ninguna fuente de tasas'));
                const newUsd = Number(data.USD);
                const newEur = Number(data.EUR);
                const effectiveDate = data.effective_date || data.date;

                usdRate = newUsd;
                eurRate = newEur;
                rateSourceDate = effectiveDate;
                rateMode = 'automatic';
                rateUpdatedAt = data.updated_at || new Date().toISOString();
                persistRates();
                updateRatesUI();
                const updatedTime = data.updated_at ? new Date(data.updated_at).toLocaleTimeString('es-VE', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', timeZone: 'America/Caracas' }) : null;
                setRateStatus(`Automática · BCV · consulta ${updatedTime || 'completada'}`, 'good');
                renderCatalog();
            } catch (error) {
                if (Number.isFinite(usdRate) && Number.isFinite(eurRate) && rateSourceDate) {
                    setRateStatus(rateMode === 'manual' ? 'Sin conexión · tasa manual guardada' : 'Sin conexión: se muestra la última tasa guardada', 'warn');
                } else {
                    rateSourceDate = null;
                    updateRatesUI();
                    setRateStatus('No se pudo consultar. Introduce una tasa verificada manualmente.', 'warn');
                    renderCatalog();
                }
                console.warn('No se pudieron actualizar las tasas automáticamente.', error);
            } finally {
                rateIsRefreshing = false;
                if (button) button.disabled = false;
                if (button) button.classList.remove('opacity-50', 'cursor-wait');
                if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            }
        }

        function toggleRateModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('rate-modal');
            modal.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        function saveRates() {
            const newUsd = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modal-usd-input').value);
            const newEur = parseFloat(document.getElementById('modal-eur-input').value);
            if (!(newUsd > 0) || !(newEur > 0)) {
                alert('Introduce tasas válidas y mayores que cero.');
                return;
            }
            usdRate = newUsd;
            eurRate = newEur;
            rateSourceDate = caracasTodayISO();
            rateMode = 'manual';
            rateUpdatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            persistRates();
            updateRatesUI();
            setRateStatus('Manual · verifica la fecha y los valores', 'warn');
            renderCatalog();
            toggleRateModal();
        }

        // Mostrar primero el último dato guardado para evitar que los precios en Bs. desaparezcan mientras carga.
        restoreRatesCache();
        loadAutomaticRates();
        // Mientras la página esté abierta, revisar periódicamente si hay una tasa más reciente.
        setInterval(() => loadAutomaticRates(), RATE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
